behaviors.description: Approve an installation with closed stdin through either automatic confirmation mode.
behaviors.preconditions: Absent independent app/runtime and a remote advertising known commits.
behaviors.expected: An ordinary invocation refuses without consent and preserves the empty installation; each automatic mode deploys exactly the app and runtime without an unanswered prompt.

mappings.rationale: Closed stdin distinguishes automatic consent from an ordinary unapproved transaction; exact independent commits verify completion.

surface_assertions.rationale: The pending installation completes without reading confirmation.
The pending installation completes without prompting or reading input.
